verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Pipedream's MCP/API layer exposes thousands of tools and even proxies raw API calls for endpoints without pre-built tools (docs-20), suggesting broad API coverage, but there is no explicit claim or comparison that every UI capability (e.g., workflow building, dashboard management, account configuration) is exposed via the API/MCP interface. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity statement, coverage of non-tool UI features like workflow builder or billing/admin actions, independent confirmation of full parity.
